priorityReview.title: Comprehensive characterisation of patients with colorectal cancer and permanently liver-limited disease.
priorityReview.sourceLevel: Primary abstract read;full clinical source unavailable
priorityReview.reason: Retrospective1026 unresectable mCRC cohort; permanence of liver-only pattern depends on subsequent observation. Full methods,follow-up,genomic and immune subset denominators,estimates/CI not verified. Cannot infer local-treatment selection benefit. Elsevier195-byte Site Unavailable;EuropePMC no fulltext.

priorityReview.title: The Impact of Tumor Molecular Profile on Prognosis for Patients With Peritoneal Metastases From Colorectal Cancer Undergoing Cytoreductive Surgery and Hyperthermic Intraperitoneal Chemotherapy.
priorityReview.sourceLevel: Primary abstract read;full clinical source unavailable
priorityReview.reason: Retrospective159 CRS-HIPEC patients;73 documented mutations. Abstract supports adjusted RFS association but not independent OS association; heterogeneous mutation group, selection and confounding require full methods. PCI>15 label vs HR1.073 requires verification. Wiley403;complete morbidity and denominators unverified.

priorityReview.title: Delayed diverting ileostomy reversal after sphincter-preserving rectal cancer surgery: Associated factors and early outcomes.
priorityReview.sourceLevel: Primary abstract read;full clinical source unavailable
priorityReview.reason: Retrospective243 patients who actually completed stoma reversal,not all diverted patients. Delay>6months associated with early outcomes; onset timing of stoma complications unreliable. Full adjusted estimates/CI,30day safety and denominators unverified. No causal benefit of earlier reversal inferred. Elsevier Site Unavailable.

priorityReview.title: Immune checkpoint inhibitor plus chemotherapy and bevacizumab in MSS/pMMR metastatic colorectal cancer: retrospective cohort
priorityReview.sourceLevel: Publisher full text and supplement read
priorityReview.reason: 123patients(31ICI/92control),PSM31/62. PFS association attenuates after liver-metastasis adjustment:HR0.604(95%CI0.345–1.057),P=.078;OS HR0.741(0.402–1.366),P=.336. Grade3+AE5/31vs16/92 uses unmatched safety denominator. Treatment-related death/discontinuation not found;mixed drugs/lines,selection/confounding. Low-priority pending,not confirmatory benefit.

priorityReview.title: Differences in treatment and outcomes between young and older patients with colorectal cancer liver metastases: an AmCORE-based study.
priorityReview.reason: Single-center retrospective351(31/164/156byage). PFS P=.019,OS P=.22;complete eligibility,time origin,followup,effectCI,safety and adjustment unavailable. Do not infer chemotherapy inefficacy or causal age effect. Earlier preprint OS P=.34 differs and cannot substitute for final paper.
